{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
completed_only = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Stratify by customer segment and compute conversion rates
conversion_by_segment = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Compute weighted average conversion rate for each channel, using segment distribution as weights
email_segment_dist = completed_only[completed_only['channel'] == 'email'].groupby('customer_segment').size() / len(completed_only[completed_only['channel'] == 'email'])
paid_search_segment_dist = completed_only[completed_only['channel'] == 'paid_search'].groupby('customer_segment').size() / len(completed_only[completed_only['channel'] == 'paid_search'])

# Compute weighted conversion rates
weighted_conv_email = (email_segment_dist * conversion_by_segment).sum()
weighted_conv_paid_search = (paid_search_segment_dist * conversion_by_segment).sum()

# Compute difference
difference = weighted_conv_email - weighted_conv_paid_search

print(f"Weighted conversion rate (email): {weighted_conv_email:.4f}")
print(f"Weighted conversion rate (paid_search): {weighted_conv_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}")"}
